<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary impasse:</strong> The Opposition, led by Congress, continues to disrupt proceedings demanding a statement from Home Minister Amit Shah regarding recent student protests, despite government assurances that it is ready for a debate.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPNkg1TVVueWZnX0JBODdqM2IxSHJOcEQxdW00N2IyOXdEMWNtbW1iQ1N2N3VnZEYxQk16WENiWDhVcGlINWJuRGZySnhMalc2UGp2U1hIa2VUdHZTVWxXeGgzSnpfdWxtYURJVUhWYV9nQmRVMFh6UURCT21WMGh6bXRGaElPU3NnMGwxYlVaWDZWdlpNaWFWWEEtZDN0VG5QVUtGM0tobHJjVnltM1NKWXFacU9rNGxyRF9UMA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative agenda:</strong> Amidst ongoing disruptions, the Lok Sabha passed the Tribunals Reforms Bill 2026, which proposes the creation of a National Tribunals Commission to oversee appointments.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPNkg1TVVueWZnX0JBODdqM2IxSHJOcEQxdW00N2IyOXdEMWNtbW1iQ1N2N3VnZEYxQk16WENiWDhVcGlINWJuRGZySnhMalc2UGp2U1hIa2VUdHZTVWxXeGgzSnpfdWxtYURJVUhWYV9nQmRVMFh6UURCT21WMGh6bXRGaElPU3NnMGwxYlVaWDZWdlpNaWFWWEEtZDN0VG5QVUtGM0tobHJjVnltM1NKWXFacU9rNGxyRF9UMA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial intervention:</strong> The Supreme Court has directed the Centre and the Assam government to respond to petitions regarding the issuance of identity cards for individuals listed in the National Register of Citizens (NRC).<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Medical policy:</strong> The Supreme Court is currently exploring the establishment of a uniform national policy to mandate rural service for medical graduates.</li>
  <li><strong>Aviation regulations:</strong> The Union government clarified in Parliament that there is currently no policy prohibiting airport operators from owning or running airlines.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
</ul>
